newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-DETTORI HITS CENTURY MARK AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-DETTORI HITS CENTURY MARK AGAIN.

text.p: Frankie Dettori hit the century of winners mark for this season when riding a double aboard Kristal Breeze and Misrule at Brighton races on Wednesday.

Dettori, achieving the feat for the fifth year in succession, said: "At one point after I broke my elbow on June 13 I thought I was never going to get the ton (100). But I made a quick recovery and now I'm on top of the world.
"Although this is not quite the impossible dream as Saturday's seven-timer, it is still a landmark."
He added: "I am still overwhelmed from Saturday -- I can't quite get over it yet."
The Italian-born champion stunned the bookmaking world last Saturday when riding all seven winners at Ascot at cumulative odds of more than 25,000-1.
But because of time lost to his injury Dettori has no chance of retaining his jockeys' title.
